description: Defines the UuidMap class for managing relationships between UUID strings, including establishing, removing, copying, and querying direct and inverse relationships.

classes.name: UuidMap
classes.description: A class that manages bidirectional relationships between UUIDs, allowing for establishing, removing, copying, and querying relationships.

methods.name: makeCopy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the UuidMap instance with duplicated relationship maps.

methods.name: getDirectRelationships
methods.description: Returns an array of UUIDs that are directly related to the given UUID.

methods.name: getInverseRelationships
methods.description: Returns an array of UUIDs that have a relationship with the given UUID.

methods.name: establishRelationship
methods.description: Establishes a bidirectional relationship between two UUIDs.

methods.name: deestablishRelationship
methods.description: Removes the bidirectional relationship between two UUIDs.

methods.name: setAllRelationships
methods.description: Sets the entire list of relationships for a UUID, updating inverse relationships accordingly.

methods.name: removeFromMap
methods.description: Removes a UUID and all its relationships from the maps.

methods.name: establishDirectRelationship
methods.description: Adds a direct relationship from one UUID to another.

methods.name: establishInverseRelationship
methods.description: Adds an inverse relationship from one UUID to another.

methods.name: deestablishDirectRelationship
methods.description: Removes a direct relationship from one UUID to another.

methods.name: deestablishInverseRelationship
methods.description: Removes an inverse relationship from one UUID to another.
